messages.text:
Hey Hrushi
*Regarding the ETL layer that has been setup for SaySo:* Mike has been setting up a front-end for a dashboard to help visualise the data for his needs. Right now, he's struggling to find a way to extract the data automatically from Athena into his dashboard (he has something setup he built through claude with next.js, so I'm not too familiar with AWS connections to it).
He was asking me to see if I can setup a google sheet to automatically pull the data from Athena each day. What's the easiest method for this with the current setup?
From my understanding, querying Athena automatically creates a csv file for the data and puts it into a S3 bucket, but I don't see an option to schedule queries, and also cant figure out how to pull that csv data atomically else where. Is a lambda script required for this or something alike?

messages.text: Building a fully automated dashboard requires considerable effort. For the launch, the idea was to combine manual effort with bit of starter infra. The way to extract data for the time being is those manual queries. We can scope a full automation as a post launch goal.
